name: @red-cup-engineering/print-on-demand-design-factory
description: Generates print-ready designs and their listing copy (title, description, tags, product targets) as code, for the Fine Print Mercantile print-on-demand shop. Two lanes: zero-cost typographic SVG rendering, and a real LLM raster-art lane (Gemini direct, OpenRouter fallback) with per-image provider/model provenance. No HTTP upload client, no account mutation.
